question: Will any of these AI companies (Lovable, DeepSeek, or Perplexity) have a funding round in December 2026?

calls.reasoning: Base rate: across the past 12 months these three companies had a funding round in roughly 4-5 months (Lovable Dec 2025 and Aug 2026, DeepSeek Jun/Jul 2026 and Nov 2026, Perplexity Nov 2026 via a filing), so about 35% per month. All three raised in the last 1-4 months (DeepSeek's ~$15B round was registered Nov 17; Perplexity's $3B Series F-2 is dated Nov 2 from a filing; Lovable's Series C was Aug 12), which lowers the chance of another round dated December. The main path to Yes is Perplexity officially announcing the round, or Nvidia's investment closing, in December and Tracxn dating it then. No matching prediction market exists; the Polymarket contracts on Perplexity being acquired (6%) or going bankrupt (3%) do not match this question. Tracxn pages were blocked (403), so its current listings could not be checked.
